block.calendar_booking.model.title: Calendar Booking
block.calendar_booking.model.description: Find shared Google Calendar availability, prepare an exact booking draft and create an event only after approval; preserve uncertain outcomes without resending.
block.calendar_booking.apply_hint: Changes remain local until Apply. Restart a loaded Run to use new settings.
block.calendar_booking.invalid_number: Check the numeric value and its limits.
block.calendar_booking.workflow: Search → select a slot → approve the exact draft. Preview never sends an invitation.
block.calendar_booking.help_enabled: Allow explicit availability requests. Preparing a Run never contacts Google.
block.calendar_booking.help_booking_enab: An exact approval on decision is still required. Invites are sent only after a successful recheck.
block.calendar_booking.help_calendar_id: Explicit Google Calendar ID, such as owner@example.com; primary and calendar URLs are refused.
block.calendar_booking.help_credential_r: secret://workspace/google_calendar — the secret contains OAuth JSON, never paste tokens here.
block.calendar_booking.help_timezone: IANA zone, for example Europe/Paris. Slots include UTC times and explicit local offsets.
block.calendar_booking.help_participants: Array of {"id":"alice","email":"alice@example.com","calendar_id":"alice@example.com"}. Requests select these IDs; [] allows meetings without guests.
block.calendar_booking.help_business_hou: Map mon–sun to intervals, e.g. {"mon":[["09:00","12:00"],["13:00","17:00"]]}. Missing days are closed. Split overnight periods.
block.calendar_booking.help_horizon_days: Furthest allowed search end from now; maximum 90 days.
block.calendar_booking.help_step_minutes: Start-time grid in the working time zone; meeting duration comes from the request.
block.calendar_booking.help_buffer_minut: Keep this margin before and after each busy period across the selected calendars.
block.calendar_booking.help_min_notice_m: Rechecked at approval, immediately before the booking attempt.
block.calendar_booking.help_max_particip: Only configured participant IDs are accepted; their free/busy calendars must be readable.
block.calendar_booking.help_max_slots: Return the first matching slots in chronological order.
block.calendar_booking.help_max_duration: Elapsed duration, including on daylight-saving transition days.
block.calendar_booking.help_draft_lifeti: Approval cannot extend an expired proposal. Start a new request to search again.
block.calendar_booking.help_timeout_sec: Total deadline per operation. A lost booking response is uncertain, never retried automatically.
block.calendar_booking.help_max_records: Durable duplicate protection per node. No automatic deletion; refuse new requests at this limit.
block.calendar_booking.help_max_storage_: Bound the private SQLite database; default 32 MiB. Credentials are never stored here.
